primary_source.read_depth: Complete main text and captions, S1-S7 captions and MIQE text. Main images 4/5 and supplementary PDF pages 3/4 (S5-S7) inspected. Other images, MIQE embedded plots and raw data not independently analyzed.

model: Ordinary mouse oocyte meiosis; genetic interaction mapping also uses NIH3T3 cells. Not BUB1B-mutant muscle.

genetic_evidence.depletion: Lower BubR1, misalignment, unstable attachments, aneuploidy
genetic_evidence.overexpression: Higher BubR1 but also abnormal maturation, misalignment and aneuploidy
genetic_evidence.mechanism: EZH2 interaction/scaffolding is distinct from catalytic methyltransferase activity
genetic_evidence.functional_rescue_limit: Figure 5C restores protein but reports no significant polar-body timing differences among control/depletion/rescue; it cannot alone demonstrate statistically resolved functional reversal

administered_compounds.name: GSK343
administered_compounds.study_supplier: Selleck; exact product ID not stated
administered_compounds.observed: Reduced H3K27me3, no obvious EZH2 protein change or significant displayed polar-body extrusion change
administered_compounds.rare_observation: S7 abnormal polar-body morphology; text describes one or two among 50 and unshown incorrect chromosome counts. No displayed drug karyotype comparison establishes safety or excess risk

administered_compounds.name: DZNep
administered_compounds.study_supplier: Millipore; exact product ID not stated
administered_compounds.observed: Reduced H3K27me3 and H3K9me2, no obvious EZH2 protein change or significant displayed polar-body extrusion change
administered_compounds.selectivity_limit: Do not interpret as a selective EZH2-only intervention or interchange with GSK343

design_limits.drug_group_oocyte_counts: not supplied for displayed drug comparisons

comparison: Retain two methylation mechanism probes. No drug-mediated deficient-model rescue, normal-muscle output, human exposure bridge or basis to replace the provisional nominees.
followup_of: MED27226494 exact GSK343 hit in separate SGC probe screen; zero added outer-corpus completion credit
